dogecoin.text: It seems obvious to me that #dogecoin is going to continue to rise as we get closer to Elon hosting SNL.  The key is to #HODL even if nothing happens on SNL or immediately after.  Don't sell just because you think nothing happened... what happened is everything leading up to SNL!

100% ditching #Robinhood after this. Everytime big stuff is happening with #dogecoin, Robinhood coincidentally has server issues and you can't do any #doge transactions. I'm new to crypto, but I now know this isn't a service that can serve me long term. It was just the easiest.
